system.description:
OPDQ. CR 2 Strange Check to create one physical copy of yourself that you control as a companion. The copy has CR 1 and half your current HP, does half damage, wears no armour and has no abilities. Creating it costs Doom +3.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.66

automation.note: Doppelgänger companion: half your current HP, CR 1, half damage, no armour, no abilities. You control it like a companion.
